answer: The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in signal, expire in hollow, and saffron lists each expiry. Anyone running 191 aliases thus needs 161 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2111 identities would post 3323 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
